name: toast-queue
title: Toast Queue
description: Compact event notifications with animated entry, dismissal, and queue limits.

useCases: Event confirmations, publishing feedback, and small app notifications.
limitations: The queue lives in the component that calls the hook; it is not a global provider.
requirements: Render ToastQueue with a useToastQueue controller. Requires React, Tailwind CSS 4, and theme tokens. Reduced motion disables entry and exit animation.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/toast-queue.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
